description: Save the buyer's contact and Singapore delivery details on a checkout. Send its current details_version; the result has the new one. Does not charge anything. Details can't change once payment preparation starts.

details.description: Contact and Singapore delivery details exactly as the buyer gave them.

no_unit_number.description: true for a landed house or other address with no unit number.

unit_number.description: e.g. #12-34. Required unless no_unit_number is true.

details_version.description: The checkout's current details_version from get_checkout (0 before any details are saved).

guest_token.description: Private guest session token from create_cart. Retain for cart, checkout and purchase-status calls; no account login needed.

name: set_checkout_details
